Northwest Ag Technologies · formed 2013

We were measuring photosynthesis from a drone in 2014.

Northwest Ag Technologies builds technology for industries before they get around to asking for it. Aerial crop science, real estate imaging, freight dispatch, soil fertility, and now software for founders and businesses. Some of it we built because our own operations needed it and no one was selling it yet. The pattern has held for over a decade.

Track record

Eight ventures since 2013.

Concluded ventures sit alongside operating ones. A company that shows only what is still running is harder to assess, not easier — and the ones that ended are where most of what we know came from. Two of the first three were other people’s software; everything since, we built.

  1. 2013

    E4 Crop IntelligenceConcluded

    Precision agriculture software

    The platform the company represented from the beginning — authorised reseller and account management, sold alongside our own soil testing rather than instead of it.

    Soil sampling and fertility servicesOperating

    Agricultural services

    There from the first year. It began as soil testing with fertility recommendations attached; today it runs as independent contract sampling labor, where the client keeps the protocol, the lab and the recommendations.

  2. 2014

    Pioneer EncircaConcluded

    Precision agriculture services

    Represented Pioneer's Encirca services in the year they reached the field — a second decision platform alongside E4, at a point when growers were still deciding whether software belonged in agronomy at all.

    AgAirConcluded

    Aerial crop science

    A drone imaging programme measuring plant photosynthesis and biomass from the air — flown years before aerial crop scouting became ordinary, and before most growers had seen a drone over a field at all.

  3. year

    Ascend ImageryConcluded

    Aerial photography

    The same aircraft and the same flying, pointed at a different industry: drone photography and imaging for real estate.

  4. 2016

    Top Line TruckingConcluded

    Transportation

    Feed ingredient and grain hauling.

  5. 2020

    Slate LogisticsConcluded

    Transportation software

    A transportation and logistics platform built in house — dispatch, load tracking and billing in one system. Written four years into running Top Line Trucking, because nothing on the market did what the freight operation actually needed.

  6. year

    Verde HouseOperating

    Software development

    A software studio building its own products and taking founders and businesses from research through launch and into operation. The first software the company builds for itself rather than represents for someone else.

Today

Two operating companies.

Each runs under its own name, serves its own customers, and is accountable for its own results. A sampling client and a software client have no reason to meet.
